g.text: Official CompTIA A+ Core 2 Exam Process — Memorize this exact order
Gather information, question users, identify changes,
Step 2: Establish a Theory of Probable Cause
Question the obvious, consider multiple approaches,
research based on symptoms (simple to complex)
Step 3: Test the Theory to Determine Cause
Confirm theory, test to verify root cause.
If not confirmed, re-establish new theory.
Step 4: Establish a Plan of Action
Plan the fix, notify affected users, consider impacts,
apply the fix, escalate if beyond expertise
Confirm resolution with user, implement preventive
Step 6: Document Findings, Actions, and Outcomes
Record symptoms, root cause, steps taken, resolution,
